name: Former AARO Director Alleges Pentagon Removed Case Resolutions Before Public Release
summary: Former AARO director Sean Kirkpatrick alleged that explanations were removed from some cases before public release. The report separately says the department clarified that illustrations accompanying an FBI triangular-object case were not photographs. The alleged direction and affected cases have not been independently documented.
